INTEGRATED SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
